title: feedback/v1
description: The feedback tool: what happened after an enhance call. Every outcome field may be null when the client does not know it.

completed.description: The run the prompt started finished and was not abandoned or failed.

tokens_in.description: Input tokens not read from or written to the cache.

asked_again.description: The author repeated or corrected the request within the same turn.

effort.description: The reasoning effort the run used, as the client names it.

commits.description: Commits the request's work made in its repository.

pr_merged.description: A pull request with those commits was merged.

ci_first_push_green.description: CI passed on the first push of that work.

reverted.description: A commit of that work was reverted within 7 days.

item_closed.description: The tracker item the work was for was closed.

correction_reason.description: Why the next prompt corrected the run, when it did.

review_findings.description: Problems a reviewer found in the change the run produced.

review_findings_severe.description: Of those, the ones the reviewer marked blocking.

person_ms.description: The person's time on the request: typing it, answering approvals, typing rework follow-ups.

rewritten_prompt.description: What the client's model wrote in place of the prompt, whether the person sent it or reverted it (rewrite_accepted says which).
